gaps.sentence: Seldom does a debut novel ___ so much critical attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Seldom does a novel receive …' — the auxiliary 'does' carries tense; base verb follows.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ it occur to her that the letter had been a forgery.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later' at the front inverts with do-support: did it occur to her.

gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.

gaps.sentence: To such extremes ___ the fans go that the police were called in.
gaps.explanation: 'To such extremes did the fans go that …' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: ___ as it may sound, the machine still works perfectly.
gaps.explanation: Adjective + as + subject + verb = although it sounds strange.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not since the 1990s ___ unemployment been so low.
gaps.explanation: Not since X has Y happened — present perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last vote had been counted ___ the returning officer speak.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when' at the front forces question order: did the returning officer speak.
